regime.title: C2PA conformance program — generator-product topics
regime.determination_by: the C2PA conformance program, and each relying party's validator configuration

source.note: program documents not fetched (c2pa.org and spec.c2pa.org were unreachable); rows are the generator topics the item-6 profile addresses

rows.requirement: A generator emits a signed C2PA manifest a validator can check.
rows.mechanism: A C2PA sidecar over an export bundle, signed under the device-derived certificate (compiled under the c2pa-export feature).
rows.limits: A v0 pre-freeze sidecar; its test runs under --features c2pa-export.

rows.requirement: A generator's manifests follow a stated profile.
Manifests read correctly in other validators.
Claim signatures carry a trusted time stamp.
rows.mechanism: A claim time stamp from the anchor TSA.

rows.requirement: Media assets carry their own manifests.
rows.mechanism: Manifests on frames disclosed through an unseal.

rows.requirement: Redactions are declared rather than hidden.
Manifests travel with the evidence they describe.
rows.mechanism: A c2pa/ section in the court kit.

rows.requirement: Generator certificates chain to the program's trust list.
rows.mechanism: A self-signed device CA with the private-credential-store path.
rows.reason: A self-signed device CA with the private-credential-store pinning path is the design; trust-list enrollment is declined (item-6 rejection 19).

rows.requirement: Manifests can be recovered through soft bindings (watermarks or fingerprints).
rows.reason: A soft binding is a content-comparable correlation substrate, which Invariants II and IV rule out.

rows.mechanism: The device seed derives the signing keys; its protection is the deployment's.
rows.operator_action: Protect the device seed per the CPS.
rows.limits: The program's assurance requirements were not read.

rows.requirement: A named person can co-sign a manifest with an identity assertion.
rows.mechanism: A CAWG identity assertion naming the person the cited receipt records.
